reply:
Hello Sofia,

1. I built an internal agent that answers sales-ops questions from Salesforce data through an MCP server I wrote, with read-only permissions. 60 account managers use it daily.
2. I keep 120 real questions with expected answers and run them every night; anything below 90% blocks the deploy.
3. Questions that need data from two systems at once. I added a small tool that joins them in SQL instead of letting the model guess.
4. Report numbers always come from SQL, never from the model; the agent only decides which query to run.
5. I'm in Santiago, Chile. English 8/10, and I can overlap 6 hours with US Eastern. I'd prefer to discuss rate on a call.

Thanks!
Camila
